title: Add Localized Tooltip to Timeline Toolbar Action
taskDescription: Add a new tooltip to the timeline 'Ripple Delete' button explaining its keyboard shortcut and action. The label must be localized across all supported languages.
expectedBehavior: Tooltip renders with semantic key via useI18n(). All 9 supported locales (en, ru, es, ja, de, fr, ko, zh-CN, zh-TW) receive the new translation key with identical placeholders.
architecturalConstraints: No hardcoded text in React JSX
100% parity across all 9 catalogs enforced by npm run i18n:check
acceptanceCriteria: Key added to en.json and all 8 other catalogs
Component test or Playwright test verifies tooltip rendering
